model:
rachana: 1
sutra: taxonomy-alignment
version: 1
description: 
match: { kind: taxonomy-alignment, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: "Climate · Green asset ratio", id: "$.reportId" }
strip:
  - { label: "Entity", bind: "$.legalEntityName" }
  - { label: "Green asset ratio", bind: "$.gar", fmt: "pct2", emphasis: true }
  - { label: "Eligible", bind: "$.eligible", fmt: "pct0" }
  - { label: "Covered assets", bind: "$.covered", fmt: "compact" }
panels:
  - id: objectives
    kind: hbar
    title: "Aligned assets by objective"
    key: "F2"
    rows: "$.objectives"
    label: "objective"
    value: "aligned"
    fmt: "compact"
  - id: built
    kind: provenance
    title: "How this view was built"
  - id: refs
    kind: links
    title: "Linked entities"
    code: "REFS"
    area: right
keys: { F7: "link($.legalEntity, 'legal-entity')", F8: "impact", F9: "raw" }
